# espalier_machines (Data Source)

All container machines in the container runtime.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "espalier_machines" "all" {}

output "default_machine" {
  value = one([for m in data.espalier_machines.all.machines : m.name if m.default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) The container machines ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `cpus` (Number) Number of CPUs. Defaults to the runtime's.
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default machine, which `container machine` commands use without `--name`. Set to `true` to make it the default; to change the default, set it on another machine (`false` cannot be set).
- `digest` (String) Digest of the image.
- `disk_size` (Number) Disk space the machine uses, in bytes.
- `gid` (Number) Account group ID. Defaults to the host user's.
- `home` (String) Home directory of the account. Defaults to `/home/<user>`.
- `home_mount` (String) How the host user's home directory is mounted: `rw`, `ro` or `none`. Defaults to `rw`.
- `id` (String) The machine's name.
- `image` (String) Image reference, resolved like `espalier_image`'s `name`; pulled if missing.
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the running machine; it may change when the machine restarts.
- `kernel` (String) Always null: the runtime does not report the kernel.
- `memory` (String) Memory, at least `1G`, with an optional `K`, `M`, `G`, `T` or `P` suffix. Defaults to half the host's.
- `name` (String) Name of the machine.
- `platform` (String) Platform of a multi-platform image (`os/arch[/variant]`). Defaults to `linux/arm64`.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the machine should run. Changes start or stop it in place; a machine stopped outside Terraform is started again. Defaults to `true`.
- `scheme` (String) Always null: the runtime does not report the registry scheme.
- `status` (String) Status as the runtime reports it, e.g. `running`.
- `uid` (Number) Account user ID. Defaults to the host user's.
- `user` (String) Account name in the machine. Defaults to the host user's.
- `virtualization` (Boolean) Always null: the runtime does not report the nested virtualization setting.
